desc: Validate the current min-cost-flow implementation against all public samples.
Exhaustively validate the full algorithm against brute-force configuration BFS on small and adversarial graphs.
Establish the three-phase parking characterization for cases without two internally vertex-disjoint \(S\)-\(T\) paths.
Verify replacement-path computation and min-cost-flow endpoint/capacity modeling.
Confirm the submitted implementation is complete and correct.
